name: Theodorus the Proconsul
bio: Theodorus the Proconsul is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 6th century AD. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Cycle of Agathias, compiled in the sixth century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 556).

poems.title: Book VII, 556: On a mime
poems.author: Theodorus the Proconsul
poems.text: Hades is grim, but he laughed at thy death, Tityrus, and made thee the mime of the dead.
